svg.title: The reserve used by a retained step is constructed for the very finite leaf inventory just described. Give each leaf its fee and normalized square-zero monomial zi. The parent support contains all pins in the monomial’s scope, and |zi|w ≤1. The marked activity expansion produces a family K(t, A) indexed by subsets of the finite leaf inventory. Its mixed jet in the leaves is evaluated on products of the zi; because z2 i = 0, only distinct-leaf derivatives survive. Thus the marked polynomial is a finite substitution in these jets. The coefficient bounds on the mixed jets yield local polynomial bounds by the triangle inequality and ∥Q izi∥w ≤1.
